title: WENETSPEECH-CHUAN: A LARGE-SCALE SICHUANESE CORPUS WITH RICH ANNOTATION FOR DIALECTAL SPEECH PROCESSING

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) performance using Character Error Rate (CER) and Text-to-Speech (TTS) synthesis quality using objective (CER, Speaker Similarity) and subjective (Intelligibility-MOS, Speaker-MOS, and Accent-MOS) metrics on newly constructed Sichuanese dialect benchmark datasets to measure and mitigate performance disparities against regional dialect speakers.
